description: This file contains utility functions for managing product stock quantities, pricing, and stock status within an ERP system, specifically for items, batches, and product bundles.

methods.name: get_qty_in_stock
methods.description: Calculates stock availability and quantity for a given item and warehouse, considering stock items and variants.

methods.name: adjust_qty_for_expired_items
methods.description: Adjusts stock quantities by subtracting expired batch quantities.

methods.name: get_expired_batches
methods.description: Returns a list of batch IDs that are expired based on current date.

methods.name: qty_from_all_warehouses
methods.description: Sums quantities from multiple warehouses for a batch.

methods.name: get_price
methods.description: Retrieves and calculates the price for an item, applying pricing rules and formatting.

methods.name: get_non_stock_item_status
methods.description: Checks if a product bundle's items are all in stock.
